trust_decision.summary: Parser decides whether an expression's AST depth is acceptable: every node it adds on a branch increments a counter that is capped at 256. At the pinned commit this check is ALREADY PRESENT.

landing_point.why: The summary names 'unbounded nesting in the expression parser'. parseExpression is the recursive descent entry, and it already calls enterNestingLevel.

fix_sites.entry_point: ExpressionLanguage::compile() with enum() (code absent at pin)
fix_sites.module_kind: core function registry; unrelated to nesting

fix_sites.entry_point: ExpressionLanguage::evaluate() null-coalesce on GetAttrNode (code absent at pin)
fix_sites.module_kind: AST node evaluator; unrelated to nesting
AST node evaluator; unrelated to nesting

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No open route remains: the parser bound already covers unary, parentheses, arrays, hashes, binary, property, index and ternary nesting (Tests/ParserTest.php:361-369). The only unbounded tree source left is unserialize of trusted serialized nodes (SerializedParsedExpression.php:35), which is easy to argue is not 'untrusted expression' input.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Deep but reasonable expressions (100 nested parens) and 64 chained ternaries with binary conditions must still parse. An over-tight cap or wrong per-ternary accounting breaks them.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Node tree rebuilt from serialized nodes, with no depth bound before evaluate/compile/destruct.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is a second producer of node trees that never goes through Parser. A maintainer adding the cap in Parser would naturally not touch it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A caller-supplied ParsedExpression (or one loaded from the PSR-6 cache at ExpressionLanguage.php:92) bypasses the parser bound.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The cache and pass-through are save/reload paths the parser check never sees. The cache pool is injected by the user.

O9_family: CWE-674 uncontrolled recursion (AST depth / native stack exhaustion)

j.j_sites_touched: ExpressionLanguage.php, Node/GetAttrNode.php, Node/UnaryNode.php (none of them in the nesting area; Parser.php untouched)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: A single depth counter only in the parenthesis branch of getPrimary, which misses binary, postfix and ternary chains.

out_of_scope_notes: The pinned tree is the 5.4-era branch (composer.json:19 php>=7.2.5). The fix diff's hunks target 6.4+/7.4 code (enum function, is_null_coalesce, match on unary operators), and none of it exists at the pin.
Range operator '..' in BinaryNode can allocate large arrays; this is resource exhaustion, a separate concern, not pursued.
